blurb: Guests take hot air balloon rides near Seattle floating above Woodinville Wine Country. Flights offer views of Seattle, Lake Washington, Puget Sound, and the Cascade and Olympic Mountain Ranges. Flights are weather dependent and mainly operate June through September with some flights in May and October.
extraNote: Hot Air Ballooning is very weather dependent making it one of the most important safety factors · Woodinville Ballooning location, 20 miles from downtown Seattle by car · June through September, sometimes May and October
